rationale: M49 W22 (#841). Pins a class-level FIELD whose initializer continues on lines that begin with a dot — `Path scriptDir = Paths.get(getClass()` then `.protectionDomain` / `.codeSource` / `.location` / `.toURI())` then `.toAbsolutePath()` / `.parent` (grails-core etc/bin/test-bisect.groovy:64) and `Builder b = pm.builder()` then `.excludeTimestamps()` / `.excludeVersion()` (CreateInputObjectTypeBuilder.groovy:38). The grammar has always allowed a leading-dot continuation at STATEMENT level (`leading_dot_call`), so the identical chain inside a method parsed; a class-level field is not a statement, and `field_declaration` ends — delimited — before the first dotted line, and the class body had no rule for a bare '.', so the parser inserted a MISSING '}' and the rest of the class body collapsed into error recovery. That is why the m12 census's largest first-error line was a bare '}' (57 files) — the census was recording collateral, not the cause. MEASURED on this exact file through the production analyzer, pre-fix vs post-fix: symbols 4 -> 5 (the `builder` property did not exist), and the two methods had NO owner (`owner=-`) pre-fix, so every edge they emitted was lost from the class; relationships 18 -> 21, of which the three added are `contains Cfg -> builder`, `contains Cfg -> methodChainControl`, `contains Cfg -> sameLineControl`. The residual reads/calls that the pre-fix parse attributed to the `(script)` pseudo-scope (`calls (script) -> builder`, `uses (script) -> parent`, `references (script) -> Builder` from a bogus `local_variable_declaration`) are attributed to the class now, which is what `forbidRelationships` below forbids. Corpus impact, grails-core @ a83f8748, all 6,564 tracked *.groovy files through the production pipeline, identical instrument on both sides and only the wasm differing (fcfead14d8c0 -> 5a1d1b21d71f): parse-failing 384 -> 370 with the failing-file SETS compared file by file — 14 FIXED, 0 REGRESSED; and on the bounded set that could be affected (the 384-file union plus a 400-file deterministic clean control, list kept at validation/m59/results/g841-w22-filelist.txt) relationships 57,127 -> 57,354 with 0 files losing a single relationship. `authoredBeforeAnalyzerRun` is false because the expectation was read off the corrected emission; the counts above are its provenance. An earlier VARIANT of this fix (the same node offered as a class-body declaration instead of as a field suffix) is what the two-file regression in reviews/m49-w22-groovy-class-body-dot-continuation.md records: it collapsed two files' entire parse into one top-level ERROR node and cost them 18 relationships. That variant is why this one binds the continuation to the field.
